title: Passenger loading zones.
officialText:
Passenger loading zones shall be designed and constructed in accordance with ICC A117.1 including
Section 503 (Passenger Loading Zones). Where there are curbs between the access aisle and the vehicle pull-up space, a curb ramp complying with ICC A117.1 including Section 406 (Curb Ramps) shall be provided.
